cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

an=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('O=S(=O)(C(F)(F)F)[N-]S(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F'))
ids=np.array([0,1,7,8,9])
target=np.array([[0,2.65,0],[-1.3,3.05,.7],[-2.8,2.8,0],[-3.05,1.3,-.7],[-2.65,0,0]])
weights=np.array([300,40,20,40,300])
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=43
AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(an,numConfs=25,params=p)
prop=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(an)
best=None
for cid in range(an.GetNumConformers()):
 AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(an,confId=cid)
 x=np.array(an.GetConformer(cid).GetPositions())
 a=x[ids].mean(0);b=target.mean(0)
 u,s,v=np.linalg.svd((x[ids]-a).T@(target-b));R=u@v
 if np.linalg.det(R)<0:u[:,-1]*=-1;R=u@v
 x=(x-a)@R+b
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(an,prop,confId=cid)
 def energy(v):
  xx=v.reshape(-1,3);d=xx[ids]-target
  E=ff.CalcEnergy(v.tolist())+np.sum(weights[:,None]*d*d)
  g=np.array(ff.CalcGrad(v.tolist())).reshape(-1,3)
  g[ids]+=2*weights[:,None]*d
  return E,g.ravel()
 opt=minimize(energy,x.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':1500,'ftol':1e-11})
 if best is None or opt.fun<best[0]:best=(opt.fun,opt.x.reshape(-1,3))
print('anion anchored energy',best[0])
anxyz=best[1]
print('anion anchors',anxyz[ids])
li=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CCN1C=CN(CC)C1=S'))
p.randomSeed=144
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(li,p); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(li)
x=np.array(li.GetConformer().GetPositions())
u=x[8]-x[9];u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
v=x[2]-x[5];v-=np.dot(v,u)*u;v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
w=np.cross(u,v)
u2=np.array([-np.cos(np.deg2rad(20))/np.sqrt(2),-np.cos(np.deg2rad(20))/np.sqrt(2),np.sin(np.deg2rad(20))])
v2=np.array([1.,-1.,0])/np.sqrt(2);w2=np.cross(u2,v2)
R=np.stack([u,v,w]).T@np.stack([u2,v2,w2])
lixyz=(x-x[9])@R+np.array([0,0,2.5])
elements=['Hg']+[a.GetSymbol() for a in an.GetAtoms()]*2+[a.GetSymbol() for a in li.GetAtoms()]*2
xyz=np.vstack([np.zeros((1,3)),anxyz,-anxyz,lixyz,-lixyz])
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(elements)}\nHg(II) with two bidentate bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide ligands and two trans 1,3-diethylimidazole-2-thione ligands\n')
 for e,pos in zip(elements,xyz):f.write(e+' '+' '.join(f'{v:.9f}' for v in pos)+'\n')
print('Hg (1-based): 1; donor O: 2,11,17,26; donor S: 41,63')
print('formula:',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(an),Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(li))
PY

for inds,plan in [([2,3,4,5,6],[0,1,7]),([10,11,12,13,14],[9,8,7])]:
 origin=anxyz[plan[1]]

for i,pt in enumerate(xyz):cf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(*pt))
m.AddConformer(cf)
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props,ignoreInterfragInteractions=False)
anchor=np.array([0,9,15,24,39,61,1,8,16,23,7,22])
targ=xyz[anchor].copy();wt=np.array([300]*6+[15]*4+[5]*2)
# Keep atoms from entering the central mercury volume.
rmin=np.array([2.15 if a.GetSymbol() in ['H','O','F','N'] else 2.8 for a in m.GetAtoms()]);rmin[[39,61]]=2.3

def e(v):
 xx=v.reshape(-1,3);d=xx[anchor]-targ
 E=ff.CalcEnergy(v.tolist())+np.sum(wt[:,None]*d*d)
 g=np.array(ff.CalcGrad(v.tolist())).reshape(-1,3);g[anchor]+=2*wt[:,None]*d
 dist=np.linalg.norm(xx,axis=1);ov=np.minimum(dist-rmin,0)

with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(elements)}\nTrans bis(thione) bis(bidentate NTf2) mercury(II); all hydrogens explicit\n')
 for e,pos in zip(elements,xyz):f.write(e+' '+' '.join(f'{v:.9f}' for v in pos)+'\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'ligands.mol')
for lo,hi in [(1,16),(16,31)]:
 dd=[]
 for i in range(lo,hi):
  for j in range(31,75):dd.append((np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j]),i+1,elements[i],j+1,elements[j]))
 print('Closest interligand contacts',sorted(dd)[:6])

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
lines=Path('xtbopt.xyz').read_text().splitlines();n=int(lines[0]);r=[x.split() for x in lines[2:]]
assert n==len(r)==75
p=np.array([x[1:4] for x in r],float);sy=[x[0] for x in r];assert np.isfinite(p).all()
print('Atom composition',dict(Counter(sy)))
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('ligands.mol',removeHs=False)
for b in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1,b.GetEndAtomIdx()+1;d=np.linalg.norm(p[i]-p[j]);
 assert 0.9<d<2.05,(i,j,d)
print('All covalent bond lengths checked.')
print('Hg-donor distances (A):',[(i+1,round(np.linalg.norm(p[i]-p[0]),4)) for i in [1,10,16,25,40,62]])
def ang(i,j):
 a=p[i]-p[0];b=p[j]-p[0];return np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(a,b)/np.linalg.norm(a)/np.linalg.norm(b),-1,1)))
print('trans S-Hg-S angle:',ang(40,62))
print('Chelate angles:',ang(1,10),ang(16,25))
normal=np.cross(p[1]-p[0],p[10]-p[0]);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal)
h=[(p[i]-p[j])@normal for i,j in [(2,1),(9,10),(17,16),(24,25)]]
assert h[0]>0 and h[1]<0 and h[2]<0 and h[3]>0
print('Wedge/dash chelate conformations retained:',h)
p-=p[0]
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{n}\nHg(NTf2)2(1,3-diethylimidazole-2-thione)2; trans-S, O,O-chelating; angstroms; explicit H\n')
 for el,v in zip(sy,p):f.write(f'{el} {v[0]:.9f} {v[1]:.9f} {v[2]:.9f}\n')
assert Path('answer.xyz').is_file()
print('Confirmed:',Path('answer.xyz').resolve())
PY
